fact: For patients seen from January 2016 to June 2018 at the Centre des Urgences de Yaoundé, the hospital information system implemented by the Ministry of Public Health and being tested in five hospitals was little used and paper patient charts were used instead; the authors add that most hospitals in Cameroon keep no patient charts, because patients take them home at discharge.
title: Monitoring of characteristics of the patients visiting an emergency center in Cameroon through the development of hospital patient database
